name: Geo Defense
shortDescription: A neon geometric tower defense game. Place laser, cannon, and tesla towers along a winding path to stop waves of advancing shape enemies before they reach your base.

generation.notes: Built from vote-and-category-analysis — inspired by Missile Command Modern (2 net votes). Tower defense is entirely absent from the 76-app catalog; this fills that strategic-placement gap while the existing defense apps (Missile Command, Space Invaders, Galaxian Blitz) all use reactive-shooting mechanics. 3 tower types: Laser (fast single-target), Cannon (slow splash), Tesla (chains 3 enemies). 10 escalating waves. Enemy types: standard squares/pentagons, tank hexagons (3x HP, 0.6x speed), flier triangles (0.6x HP, 1.4x speed). Upgrade system (2 levels per tower) and sell mechanic. Keyboard shortcuts 1-5 for tower selection. Shell-layout safe: fixed top:64px/bottom:56px wrapper.
